content: Hello, I am Cedar Insurance's digital assistant. This call is recorded. Am I speaking with Mx Alex Rowan?
Yes, this is Alex Rowan speaking.
Before we continue, I need to confirm your identity. Could you please tell me your policyholder code?
Sure, it's zero zero zero eight one nine.
Thank you. Could you please tell me your postcode?
Thank you. I am calling about overdue insurance premiums. Your motor premium has 480.00 past due and is 3 days late. Can you pay the full overdue amount today?
Four hundred and eighty is too much for me right now, I'm afraid.
The minimum for the motor premium is 160.00. Could you pay 160.00 on Wednesday 14 October 2026? The remaining balance stays overdue.
I could manage the one hundred and sixty, but could I pay it on October fifteenth instead of today? And would that clear everything?
No, this will not clear everything. To confirm: the motor premium, 160.00 on Thursday 15 October 2026. Do you confirm this?
I understand the rest stays overdue. Yes, I confirm.
Your promise is recorded: the motor premium, 160.00 on Thursday 15 October 2026. A premium-promise receipt will be placed in the secure inbox. Is there anything else I can help you with?
No, that's everything, thank you for your help. Goodbye.
Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
